title: Total influence as expected gradient norm
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every real-valued function $f$ on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, its total influence is the uniform expectation of the squared Euclidean norm of its discrete gradient: $\\operatorname{Inf}_{\\mathrm{tot}}(f)=\\mathbb{E}_{x\\sim\\mathrm{Unif}(\\{-1,1\\}^n)}\\lVert\\nabla f(x)\\rVert^2$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional cube
